== Side effect? ==

I don't think protecting dreams is an unintended side effect of the medallion. Mat asked to be free of  Aes Sedai, and the medallion protects him from the power. Aes Sedai in the past (and now Egwene) have also been dreamwalkers, so the medallion protects him from them in his sleep too.
